quality.hud.label: Quality
quality.bench.title: Benchmark results
quality.bench.syntheticNote: These numbers are synthetic, made up for this demo page. They are not a measurement of this device.
quality.bench.verdict.smooth.desc: Every view’s 95th-percentile frame cost is within the {smooth} budget for 60 fps.
quality.bench.verdict.playable.desc: Every view is within the {playable} budget for 30 fps. {view} costs {ms} at the 95th percentile, over the {smooth} budget for 60 fps.
quality.bench.verdict.slow.desc: {view} costs {ms} at the 95th percentile, over the {playable} budget for 30 fps.
quality.bench.verdict.none.desc: No frames could be measured, so there is no result.
quality.bench.note: The suggested preset is an estimate from a simple cost model, not a measurement. The Auto preset measures while you play and adapts.
quality.bench.caption: Frame cost per view, lower is better. Budgets: {smooth} for 60 fps, {playable} for 30 fps.
quality.bench.definition: Frame cost: from the start of a frame’s work until the GPU has finished it, without waiting for the display. CPU and GPU work do not overlap in this measure, so frames while playing are usually faster. Measured on this device.
